    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            document.querySelectorAll('form.simple-form-ajax').forEach(form => {
                form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const form = e.target;
                    const method = (form.getAttribute('method') || 'GET').toUpperCase();
                    const action = form.action || window.location.href;
                    const formData = new FormData(form, e.submitter);
                    formData.append('ajax', 1);

                    let url = action;
                    let options = {
                        method,
                        headers: {}
                    };

                    if (method === 'GET') {
                        const params = new URLSearchParams(formData).toString();
                        url += (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + params;
                    } else {
                        options.body = formData;
                    }

                    try {
                        var response = await fetch(url, options);
                        var result = await response.json(); // или .json()
                    } catch (err) {
                        ajax_toast('error', err, 15);
                        return;
                    }

                    if (result.error && "form" in result.error) {
                        console.error(result.error);
                        ajax_toast('error', result.error.form, 30);
                        return;
                    }

                    if (!response.ok) {
                        ajax_toast('error', "Неизвестная ошибка, попробуйте снова", 30);
                        return;
                    }

                    if ("toastOnSuccess" in form.dataset) {
                        ajax_toast('success', result.data.form);
                    }

                    if ("closeOnSuccess" in form.dataset) {
                        let target = document.getElementById(form.dataset.closeOnSuccess) || form;
                        target.remove();
                    }
                })
            })
        })
    </script>
    <script>
    function ajax_toast(level, message, timeoutSeconds) {
        const body = `<div class="alert alert-${level}"><a class="close" data-dismiss="alert" href="#">&times;</a>${message}</div>`;
        const container = document.querySelector('.container');
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.innerHTML = body;
        const ele = div.firstChild;
        container.prepend(ele);
        if (timeoutSeconds > 0 ) {
            setTimeout(() => {
                ele.remove();
            }, timeoutSeconds*1000)
        }
    }
    </script>

<script>
// Исключаем кнопку рулетки (#roulette-trigger) из dropdown-логики, т.к. она открывает модал
let dropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('.header-item_dropbtn, .main-header-avatar, .main-header-create, .main-header-notifications:not(#roulette-trigger)');
let dropdownContents = document.querySelectorAll('.header-item_dropdown-content, .main-header-avatar_dropdown-menu, .main-header-create_dropdown-menu, .main-header-notifications_dropdown-menu');

for (let i = 0; i < dropdowns.length; i++) {
  dropdowns[i].addEventListener('click', function () {
    this.classList.toggle('active');
    dropdownContents[i].classList.toggle('active');
    if (dropdownContents[i].style.visibility === 'visible') {
      dropdownContents[i].style.visibility = 'hidden';
    } else {
      dropdownContents[i].style.visibility = 'visible';
    }

    for (let j = 0; j < dropdowns.length; j++) {
      if (dropdowns[j] !== this) {
        try {

            dropdowns[j].classList.remove('active');
            dropdownContents[j].classList.remove('active');
            dropdownContents[j].style.visibility = 'hidden';
        }
        catch {
            continue;
        }
      }
    }
  });

  dropdowns[i].addEventListener('mouseover', function () {
    for (let j = 0; j < dropdowns.length; j++) {
      if (dropdowns[j] !== this) {
        try {

            dropdowns[j].classList.remove('active');
            dropdownContents[j].classList.remove('active');
            dropdownContents[j].style.visibility = 'hidden';
        }
        catch {
            continue;
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

window.onclick = function (event) {
  if (event.target.matches('.header-login-input')) {
    document.querySelector('.main-header-avatar_dropdown-menu').style.visibility = 'visible';
  }
  if (!event.target.matches('.header-item_dropbtn, .main-header-avatar, .main-header-create, .main-header-notifications, .header-login-input')) {
    for (let i = 0; i < dropdowns.length; i++) {
        try{

            dropdowns[i].classList.remove('active');
            dropdownContents[i].classList.remove('active');
            dropdownContents[i].style.visibility = 'hidden';
        }
        catch{
            continue;
        }
    }
  }
};
</script>

  // Сопоставление типов призов с иконками
  var ICON_MAP = {
    'free_chapter': 'gift',
    'free_book': 'gift',
    'discount': 'percent',
    'sale': 'percent',
    'merch_discount': 'percent',
    'discount_subscription': 'percent',
    'tokens': 'ticket',
    'empty': 'question',
    'unknown': 'question'
  };

  function initWheel() {
    if (!wheelContainer) wheelContainer = document.getElementById('rlt-wheel-svg');
  }

  function buildWheelFromPrizes(prizes) {
    initWheel();
    if (!wheelContainer) return;
    var items = Array.isArray(prizes) ? prizes.slice() : [];
    items = items
      .filter(function (p) { return p && p.type; })
      .map(function (p) {
        return {
          id: p.id,
          type: p.type,
          title: p.title,
          weight: parseInt(p.weight, 10) || 1
        };
      });
    var made = makeSegments(items);
    displaySegments = made.segments;
    overflowIdSet = made.overflowSet;
    questionIndex = made.questionIndex;
    renderSvgWheel();
    buildLegend();
  }

  function makeSegments(items) {
    var segments = [];
    var overflowSet = {};
    var qIdx = -1;
    if (items.length === 0) {
      for (var i = 0; i < N_SEGS; i++) {
        segments.push({ id: null, type: 'unknown', title: 'Случайный', iconKey: 'question' });
      }
      return { segments: segments, overflowSet: overflowSet, questionIndex: 0 };
    }
    var visiblePool = [];
    if (items.length > N_SEGS - 1) {
      items.sort(function (a, b) { return (b.weight || 1) - (a.weight || 1); });
      visiblePool = items.slice(0, N_SEGS - 1);
      var rest = items.slice(N_SEGS - 1);
      for (var r = 0; r < rest.length; r++) {
        if (rest[r].id != null) overflowSet[rest[r].id] = 1;
      }
    } else {
      visiblePool = items.slice();
    }
    segments = distributeWithoutAdjacency(visiblePool, N_SEGS - 1);
    var insertAt = 1;
    segments.splice(insertAt, 0, { id: null, type: 'unknown', title: 'Случайный', iconKey: 'question' });
    qIdx = insertAt;

    while (segments.length < N_SEGS) {
      segments.push({ id: null, type: 'unknown', title: 'Случайный', iconKey: 'question' });
    }

    for (var j = 0; j < segments.length; j++) {
      var t = segments[j].type;
      segments[j].iconKey = ICON_MAP[t] || 'question';
    }
    return { segments: segments, overflowSet: overflowSet, questionIndex: qIdx };
  }

  function distributeWithoutAdjacency(pool, targetLen) {
    var out = [];
    if (pool.length === 0) {
      for (var z = 0; z < targetLen; z++) out.push({ id: null, type: 'unknown', title: 'Случайный', weight: 1 });
      return out;
    }
    var items = pool.slice();
    var counts = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
      counts[items[i].id + '|' + items[i].type] = 0;
    }
    for (var pos = 0; pos < targetLen; pos++) {
      items.sort(function (a, b) {
        var ka = (counts[a.id + '|' + a.type] || 0);
        var kb = (counts[b.id + '|' + b.type] || 0);
        if (ka !== kb) return ka - kb;
        return (b.weight || 1) - (a.weight || 1);
      });
      var last = out.length ? (out[out.length - 1].id + '|' + out[out.length - 1].type) : null;
      var chosen = null;
      for (var j = 0; j < items.length; j++) {
        var key = items[j].id + '|' + items[j].type;
        if (key !== last || items.length === 1) { chosen = items[j]; break; }
      }
      if (!chosen) { chosen = items[0]; }
      out.push({ id: chosen.id, type: chosen.type, title: chosen.title, weight: chosen.weight });
      counts[chosen.id + '|' + chosen.type] = (counts[chosen.id + '|' + chosen.type] || 0) + 1;
    }
    if (out.length > 1 &&
      (out[0].id + '|' + out[0].type) === (out[out.length - 1].id + '|' + out[out.length - 1].type) &&
      pool.length > 1) {
      for (var k = 1; k < out.length - 1; k++) {
        if ((out[k].id + '|' + out[k].type) !== (out[0].id + '|' + out[0].type) &&
          (out[k - 1].id + '|' + out[k - 1].type) !== (out[0].id + '|' + out[0].type)) {
          var tmp = out[out.length - 1];
          out[out.length - 1] = out[k];
          out[k] = tmp;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  function renderSvgWheel(highlightIndex) {
    if (!wheelContainer) return;

    if (typeof highlightIndex !== 'undefined') {
      currentHighlightIndex = highlightIndex;
    }

    var N = displaySegments.length;
    var theta = Math.PI * 2 / N;
    var iconSize = 24;

    var defs = '<defs>' +
      '<linearGradient id="segGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">' +
      '<stop offset="0%" stop-color="' + GRADIENT_START + '" />' +
      '<stop offset="100%" stop-color="' + GRADIENT_END + '" />' +
      '</linearGradient>' +
      '<linearGradient id="goldGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">' +
      '<stop offset="0%" stop-color="' + GOLD_GRADIENT_START + '" />' +
      '<stop offset="100%" stop-color="' + GOLD_GRADIENT_END + '" />' +
      '</linearGradient>' +
      '<filter id="dropShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">' +
      '<feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="2" flood-color="rgba(0,0,0,0.3)" />' +
      '</filter>' +
      '</defs>';

    var svg = '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="' + WHEEL_SIZE + '" height="' + WHEEL_SIZE + '" viewBox="0 0 ' + WHEEL_SIZE + ' ' + WHEEL_SIZE + '" style="display:block;">' +
      defs;

    svg += '<circle cx="' + R + '" cy="' + R + '" r="' + (R - 2) + '" fill="#F5F5F7" stroke="#E5E5E6" stroke-width="4" />';

    svg += '<g id="rltWheelRot">';

    for (var i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      var midAngle = (i + 0.5) * theta;

      var rIn = 50;
      var rOut = R - 14;
      var strokeW = 12;
      var visualGap = 6;

      var halfTotalGapOut = (visualGap + strokeW) / 2;
      var halfTotalGapIn = 12;

      var dAngIn = Math.asin(halfTotalGapIn / rIn);
      var dAngOut = Math.asin(halfTotalGapOut / rOut);

      var aStartIn = midAngle - theta / 2 + dAngIn;
      var aEndIn = midAngle + theta / 2 - dAngIn;
      var aStartOut = midAngle - theta / 2 + dAngOut;
      var aEndOut = midAngle + theta / 2 - dAngOut;

      var isHighlighted = (i === currentHighlightIndex);
      var opacity = (currentHighlightIndex >= 0) ? (isHighlighted ? 1.0 : 0.5) : 1.0;
      var fillUrl = isHighlighted ? 'url(#goldGrad)' : 'url(#segGrad)';

      var rPathTip = 46;

      var halfTotalGap = (visualGap + strokeW) / 2;
      var sinAlpha = Math.sin(theta / 2);

      var rFillet = (rPathTip * sinAlpha - halfTotalGap) / (1 - sinAlpha);
      var rCenter = rPathTip + rFillet;
      var lProj = rCenter * Math.cos(theta / 2);
      var rTan = Math.sqrt(lProj * lProj + halfTotalGap * halfTotalGap);
      var dAngTan = Math.asin(halfTotalGap / rTan);
      var aStartTan = midAngle - theta / 2 + dAngTan;
      var aEndTan = midAngle + theta / 2 - dAngTan;
      var pTan1 = polarToCart(rTan, aStartTan);
      var pTan2 = polarToCart(rTan, aEndTan);

      var cornerRad = 16;
      var rOutPath = rOut;

      var rSideLimit = rOutPath - cornerRad;
      var dAngSideLimit = Math.asin(halfTotalGap / rSideLimit);
      var aStartSide = midAngle - theta / 2 + dAngSideLimit;
      var aEndSide = midAngle + theta / 2 - dAngSideLimit;
      var pSide1 = polarToCart(rSideLimit, aStartSide);
      var pSide2 = polarToCart(rSideLimit, aEndSide);

      var dAngCorner = cornerRad / rOutPath;
      var dAngOutBase = Math.asin(halfTotalGap / rOutPath);
      var aStartOutBase = midAngle - theta / 2 + dAngOutBase;
      var aEndOutBase = midAngle + theta / 2 - dAngOutBase;

      var aStartArc = aStartOutBase + dAngCorner;
      var aEndArc = aEndOutBase - dAngCorner;
      var pArc1 = polarToCart(rOutPath, aStartArc);
      var pArc2 = polarToCart(rOutPath, aEndArc);

      var pCorner1 = polarToCart(rOutPath, aStartOutBase);
      var pCorner2 = polarToCart(rOutPath, aEndOutBase);

      var cmd = 'M ' + pTan1.x + ' ' + pTan1.y;
      cmd += ' L ' + pSide1.x + ' ' + pSide1.y;
      cmd += ' Q ' + pCorner1.x + ' ' + pCorner1.y + ' ' + pArc1.x + ' ' + pArc1.y;
      cmd += ' A ' + rOutPath + ' ' + rOutPath + ' 0 0 1 ' + pArc2.x + ' ' + pArc2.y;
      cmd += ' Q ' + pCorner2.x + ' ' + pCorner2.y + ' ' + pSide2.x + ' ' + pSide2.y;
      cmd += ' L ' + pTan2.x + ' ' + pTan2.y;
      cmd += ' A ' + rFillet + ' ' + rFillet + ' 0 0 1 ' + pTan1.x + ' ' + pTan1.y;
      cmd += ' Z';

      svg += '<path d="' + cmd + '" fill="' + fillUrl + '" stroke="' + fillUrl + '" stroke-width="' + strokeW + '" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="' + opacity + '" />';
    }

    for (var j = 0; j < N; j++) {
      var a = j * theta + theta / 2;
      var rIcon = R * 0.65;
      var x = R + rIcon * Math.cos(a);
      var y = R + rIcon * Math.sin(a);

      var iconKey = displaySegments[j].iconKey;
      var iconContent = ICONS_SVG[iconKey] || ICONS_SVG['question'];
      var rotDeg = (a * 180 / Math.PI) + 90;

      var isHighlightedIcon = (j === currentHighlightIndex);
      var iconOpacity = (currentHighlightIndex >= 0) ? (isHighlightedIcon ? 1.0 : 0.5) : 1.0;

      svg += '<g transform="translate(' + x + ',' + y + ') rotate(' + rotDeg + ') translate(' + (-iconSize / 2) + ',' + (-iconSize / 2) + ')" opacity="' + iconOpacity + '">' +
        '<svg width="' + iconSize + '" height="' + iconSize + '" viewBox="0 0 15 15" style="overflow:visible;">' +
        iconContent +
        '</svg></g>';
    }

    svg += '</g>'; // rltWheelRot

    var hubR = 32;
    svg += '<circle cx="' + R + '" cy="' + R + '" r="' + hubR + '" fill="url(#segGrad)" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="4" />';

    var centerIconSize = 16;
    svg += '<g transform="translate(' + (R - 20) + ',' + (R - 8) + ')">' +
      '<svg width="' + centerIconSize + '" height="' + centerIconSize + '" viewBox="0 0 16 12">' + ICONS_SVG['ticket'] + '</svg>' +
      '</g>';
    var balance = (state && state.response && state.response.wallet_balance) ? state.response.wallet_balance : '...';
    svg += '<text x="' + (R + 10) + '" y="' + (R + 4) + '" fill="#fff" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">' + balance + '</text>';

    svg += '<g filter="url(#dropShadow)">';
    svg += '<path d="M ' + (R - 18) + ' -8 L ' + (R - 4.5) + ' 30 Q ' + R + ' 38 ' + (R + 4.5) + ' 30 L ' + (R + 18) + ' -8 Z" fill="' + POINTER_COLOR + '" stroke="white" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" />';
    svg += '</g>';

    svg += '</svg>';

    wheelContainer.innerHTML = svg;
    applyRotation(wheelCurrentRot);
  }

  function polarToCart(r, angle) {
    return {
      x: R + r * Math.cos(angle),
      y: R + r * Math.sin(angle)
    };
  }

  function applyRotation(rad) {
    var rot = document.getElementById('rltWheelRot');
    if (!rot) return;
    var deg = (rad * 180 / Math.PI);
    rot.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(' + deg + ' ' + R + ' ' + R + ')');
  }

  function buildLegend() {
    var holder = document.getElementById('rlt-legend');
    if (!holder) return;
    holder.innerHTML = '';
    var seen = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < displaySegments.length; i++) {
      var seg = displaySegments[i];
      var key = (seg && seg.id != null) ? ('id:' + seg.id) : ('type:' + seg.type);
      if (seen[key]) continue;
      seen[key] = 1;

      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'rlt-legend-item';

      var iconKey = seg.iconKey || ICON_MAP[seg.type] || 'question';
      var iconSvgRaw = ICONS_SVG[iconKey] || ICONS_SVG['question'];
      // В легенде фон светлый, поэтому принудительно красим иконки в чёрный
      var iconSvg = iconSvgRaw.replace(/fill="white"/g, 'fill="#000000"');

      var iconWrap = document.createElement('span');
      iconWrap.className = 'rlt-legend-color';
      iconWrap.innerHTML = '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 15 15">' + iconSvg + '</svg>';

      var text = document.createElement('span');
      text.textContent = ' ' + (seg.title || 'Приз');

      row.appendChild(iconWrap);
      row.appendChild(text);
      holder.appendChild(row);
    }
  }

  function findSegmentIndexByOutcome(outcome) {
    if (!outcome) return -1;
    if (typeof outcome.id !== 'undefined' && outcome.id !== null) {
      if (overflowIdSet[outcome.id]) return (questionIndex >= 0 ? questionIndex : -1);
    }
    if (typeof outcome.id !== 'undefined' && outcome.id !== null) {
      for (var i = 0; i < displaySegments.length; i++) {
        if (displaySegments[i].id == outcome.id) return i;
      }
    }
    if (outcome.type) {
      for (var j = 0; j < displaySegments.length; j++) {
        if (displaySegments[j].type === outcome.type) return j;
      }
    }
    if (questionIndex >= 0) return questionIndex;
    return -1;
  }

  function easeOutCubic(t) { return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3); }

  function spinToIndex(index, onDone) {
    initWheel();
    if (!wheelContainer || displaySegments.length === 0) { if (onDone) onDone(); return; }
    if (index < 0) {
      if (questionIndex >= 0) index = questionIndex;
      else { if (onDone) onDone(); return; }
    }
    var N = displaySegments.length;
    var theta = Math.PI * 2 / N;
    var spins = 6, jitter = 0;
    var target = spins * (Math.PI * 2) + (-Math.PI / 2 - (index + 0.5) * theta + jitter);
    var duration = 4200;
    var startTs = null;
    var startRot = wheelCurrentRot;
    var delta = target - startRot;
    delta = ((delta % (Math.PI * 2)) + Math.PI * 2) % (Math.PI * 2) + Math.PI * 2 * spins;
    function step(ts) {
      if (startTs === null) startTs = ts;
      var t = (ts - startTs) / duration; if (t > 1) t = 1;
      var p = easeOutCubic(t);
      wheelCurrentRot = startRot + delta * p;
      applyRotation(wheelCurrentRot);
      if (t < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
      else {
        wheelCurrentRot = startRot + delta;
        applyRotation(wheelCurrentRot);
        if (onDone) onDone();
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  // Адаптив: подгоняем размеры колеса и тела модалки под вьюпорт
  function reflowRouletteModal() {
    var modal = document.getElementById('rouletteModal');
    if (!modal || !modal.classList || !modal.classList.contains('in')) return;
    var body = modal.querySelector('.modal-body');
    var header = modal.querySelector('.modal-header');
    var footer = modal.querySelector('.modal-footer');
    var vh = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight || 600;
    var vw = window.innerWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth || 800;
    var headerH = header ? header.offsetHeight : 0;
    var footerH = footer ? footer.offsetHeight : 0;
    var maxBody = Math.max(220, vh - headerH - footerH - 40);
    if (body) { body.style.maxHeight = maxBody + 'px'; }
    var stateBox = document.getElementById('roulette-state');
    var controls = document.getElementById('roulette-controls');
    var info = document.getElementById('roulette-info');
    var legend = document.getElementById('rlt-legend');
    function h(el) { return (el && el.offsetParent !== null) ? el.offsetHeight : 0; }
    var othersH = h(stateBox) + h(controls) + h(info) + h(legend) + 30;
    var modalWidth = Math.min(Math.floor(vw * 0.96), 720);
    var availW = modalWidth - 40;
    var availH = Math.max(160, maxBody - othersH);
    var size = Math.max(180, Math.min(availW, availH, 360));
    var wrap = document.getElementById('rlt-wheel-wrap');
    var svgWrap = document.getElementById('rlt-wheel-svg');
    if (wrap) { wrap.style.width = size + 'px'; wrap.style.height = size + 'px'; }
    if (svgWrap) { svgWrap.style.width = size + 'px'; svgWrap.style.height = size + 'px'; }
    if (size !== WHEEL_SIZE) {
      WHEEL_SIZE = size; R = WHEEL_SIZE / 2;
      renderSvgWheel();
    }
  }

  // Префлайт: вычислить WHEEL_SIZE до первой отрисовки, чтобы избежать «дёргания»
  function reflowRouletteModalPreflight() {
    var modal = document.getElementById('rouletteModal');
    if (!modal) return;
    var vh = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight || 600;
    var vw = window.innerWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth || 800;
    var modalWidth = Math.min(Math.floor(vw * 0.96), (vw >= 768 ? 450 : Math.floor(vw * 0.96)));
    var availW = modalWidth - 40;
    var approxOthers = (vw >= 768 ? 200 : 180);
    var maxBody = Math.max(220, vh - 160);
    var availH = Math.max(160, maxBody - approxOthers);
    var size = Math.max(180, Math.min(availW, availH, 360));
    var wrap = document.getElementById('rlt-wheel-wrap');
    var svgWrap = document.getElementById('rlt-wheel-svg');
    if (wrap) { wrap.style.width = size + 'px'; wrap.style.height = size + 'px'; }
    if (svgWrap) { svgWrap.style.width = size + 'px'; svgWrap.style.height = size + 'px'; }
    if (size !== WHEEL_SIZE) {
      WHEEL_SIZE = size; R = WHEEL_SIZE / 2;
    }
  }

  function updateHeaderCount(s) {
    try {
      var free = parseInt(s.response.free_spins_remaining || 0, 10);
      var cost = parseInt(s.response.paid_spin_cost_tokens || 0, 10);
      var bal = parseInt(s.response.wallet_balance || 0, 10);
      var maxPerDay = parseInt(s.response.max_paid_spins_per_day || 0, 10);
      var usedToday = parseInt(s.response.paid_spins_used_today || 0, 10);
      var paidByTokens = cost > 0 ? Math.floor(bal / cost) : 0;
      var paidByLimit = maxPerDay > 0 ? Math.max(0, maxPerDay - usedToday) : paidByTokens;
      var paidAvail = maxPerDay > 0 ? Math.min(paidByTokens, paidByLimit) : paidByTokens;
      var total = (s.response.has_prizes_today === false) ? 0 : (free + paidAvail);
      var el = document.getElementById('roulette-count');
      if (!el) return;
      if (total > 0) { el.style.display = 'inline'; el.innerHTML = '<b>(' + total + ')</b>'; } else { el.style.display = 'none'; }
    } catch (e) { }
  }

  function renderModal(s, preserveWheelAndInfo) {
    try {
      var cost = s.response.paid_spin_cost_tokens;
      var costText = cost + ' ' + pluralForm(cost, 'токен', 'токена', 'токенов');
      document.getElementById('rlt-balance').textContent = s.response.wallet_balance;
      document.getElementById('rlt-free').textContent = s.response.free_spins_remaining;
      document.getElementById('rlt-cost').textContent = costText;
      var maxPerDay = s.response.max_paid_spins_per_day;
      var used = s.response.paid_spins_used_today;
      var lim = document.getElementById('rlt-daily-limit');
      if (maxPerDay > 0) { lim.style.display = 'block'; lim.textContent = 'Платные крутки сегодня: ' + used + ' из ' + maxPerDay; } else { lim.style.display = 'none'; }
      var btnFree = document.getElementById('rlt-spin-free');
      var btnPaid = document.getElementById('rlt-spin-paid');
      btnFree.disabled = !(s.response.free_spins_remaining > 0);
      var costVal = s.response.paid_spin_cost_tokens;
      btnPaid.textContent = 'Крутить за ' + (costVal || '—');
      var paidByTokens = costVal > 0 ? Math.floor(s.response.wallet_balance / costVal) : 0;
      var paidByLimit = (maxPerDay > 0) ? Math.max(0, maxPerDay - s.response.paid_spins_used_today) : paidByTokens;
      var paidAvail = (maxPerDay > 0) ? Math.min(paidByTokens, paidByLimit) : paidByTokens;
      btnPaid.disabled = !(paidAvail > 0);
      // Обновление информационного блока только если не просили сохранить текущее сообщение
      if (!preserveWheelAndInfo) {
        var info = document.getElementById('roulette-info');
        if (!info) {
          // ничего
        } else if (s.response.has_prizes_today === false) {
          btnFree.disabled = true;
          btnPaid.disabled = true;
          info.style.display = 'block';
          info.className = 'alert alert-warning';
          info.textContent = 'Сегодня призов нет';
        } else {
          // Состояние по умолчанию: есть призы, просто подсказываем крутить
          info.style.display = 'block';
          info.className = 'alert alert-info';
          info.textContent = 'Крутите, чтобы выиграть!';
        }
      }
    } catch (e) { }

    if (!preserveWheelAndInfo) {
      reflowRouletteModalPreflight();
      buildWheelFromPrizes((s && s.response && s.response.visible_prizes) ? s.response.visible_prizes : []);
    }
    reflowRouletteModal();
  }

  function loadState(cb) {
    fetch('/api/roulette/state', { credentials: 'include' })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (j) { if (j && j.status === 'success') { state = j; updateHeaderCount(j); if (cb) cb(j); } })
      .catch(function () { });
  }

  function showOutcome(out) {
    var wrap = document.getElementById('rlt-wheel-wrap');
    if (!wrap) return;

    var existing = wrap.querySelectorAll('.rlt-result-pill');
    for (var i = 0; i < existing.length; i++) existing[i].remove();

    var rawTitle = (out && out.title) ? out.title : '—';
    var title = escapeHtml(rawTitle);
    if (out && out.type === 'tokens') {
      var amt = (out.details && out.details.amount) || '0';
      title = amt + ' ' + pluralForm(amt, 'токен', 'токена', 'токенов');
    }

    var t = out && out.type ? out.type : 'unknown';
    var iconKey = ICON_MAP[t] || 'question';
    var iconSvg = ICONS_SVG[iconKey] || ICONS_SVG['question'];

    var pill = document.createElement('div');
    pill.className = 'rlt-result-pill';
    pill.innerHTML =
      '<div class="rlt-result-pill-icon"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 15 15" style="width:18px;height:18px;">' + iconSvg + '</svg></div>' +
      '<div class="rlt-result-pill-text">' + title + '</div>';

    pill.addEventListener('click', function () {
      pill.remove();
    });

    wrap.appendChild(pill);

    // Дублируем сообщение в информационный блок под кнопками (с ссылкой на книгу, если есть)
    var info = document.getElementById('roulette-info');
    if (info) {
      var html = 'Вы выиграли: ' + escapeHtml(rawTitle);
      // Токены
      if (out && out.type === 'tokens') {
        var amtInfo = (out.details && out.details.amount) || '0';
        html = 'Вы выиграли: ' + amtInfo + ' ' + pluralForm(amtInfo, 'токен', 'токена', 'токенов');
      }
      // Книжные призы: добавляем конкретику (кол-во глав / % скидки), если бэкенд прислал
      if (out && out.type === 'free_chapter') {
        var cnt = (out.details && (out.details.count_chapters || out.details.count)) ? parseInt(out.details.count_chapters || out.details.count, 10) : 0;
        if (cnt > 0) {
          var adj = pluralForm(cnt, 'бесплатную', 'бесплатные', 'бесплатных');
          var noun = pluralForm(cnt, 'главу', 'главы', 'глав');
          html = 'Вы выиграли: ' + cnt + ' ' + adj + ' ' + noun;
        }
      }
      if (out && out.type === 'discount_subscription') {
        var perc = (out.details && typeof out.details.percent !== 'undefined') ? parseInt(out.details.percent, 10) : 0;
        if (perc > 0) {
          html = 'Вы выиграли: скидка ' + perc + '% на покупку глав';
        }
      }
      if (out && out.details && out.details.book_url && out.details.book_title) {
        html += ' — <a href="' + escapeHtml(out.details.book_url) + '" target="_blank">' +
          escapeHtml(out.details.book_title) + '</a>';
      }
      info.className = 'alert alert-success';
      info.innerHTML = html;
      info.style.display = 'block';
    }
  }

  function escapeHtml(s) { return (s || '').replace(/[&<>]/g, function (c) { return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;' }[c] || c; }); }

  function pluralForm(n, one, two, five) {
    n = Math.abs(n) % 100;
    var n1 = n % 10;
    if (n > 10 && n < 20) return five;
    if (n1 > 1 && n1 < 5) return two;
    if (n1 === 1) return one;
    return five;
  }

  function spin(costType) {
    var bf = document.getElementById('rlt-spin-free'); var bp = document.getElementById('rlt-spin-paid');
    if (bf) bf.disabled = true; if (bp) bp.disabled = true;

    var wrap = document.getElementById('rlt-wheel-wrap');
    if (wrap) {
      var pills = wrap.querySelectorAll('.rlt-result-pill');
      for (var k = 0; k < pills.length; k++) pills[k].remove();
    }
    renderSvgWheel(-1);

    var csrfToken = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]').getAttribute('content');
    var formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('csrf_token', csrfToken);
    fetch('/api/roulette/spin?cost_type=' + encodeURIComponent(costType), { method: 'POST', credentials: 'include', body: formData })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (j) {
        var info = document.getElementById('roulette-info');
        if (j && j.status === 'success') {
          var outcome = j.response && j.response.outcome ? j.response.outcome : null;
          var idx = findSegmentIndexByOutcome({ id: outcome ? outcome.id : null, type: outcome ? outcome.type : null });
          if (idx < 0) idx = -1;
          spinToIndex(idx, function () {
            showOutcome(outcome);
            renderSvgWheel(idx);
            loadState(function (s) { renderModal(s, true); });
          });
          return;
        } else {
          if (info) {
            if (j && (j.msg === 'no_prizes_today' || j.msg === 'no_available_prizes')) {
              info.className = 'alert alert-warning';
              info.textContent = 'Сегодня призов нет';
            } else {
              info.className = 'alert alert-error';
              info.textContent = 'Ошибка: ' + (j && j.msg ? j.msg : '');
            }
            info.style.display = 'block';
          }
          loadState(function (s) { renderModal(s, true); });
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        var info = document.getElementById('roulette-info');
        if (info) {
          info.className = 'alert alert-error';
          info.textContent = 'Ошибка сети';
          info.style.display = 'block';
        }
        loadState(function (s) { renderModal(s, true); });
      });
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    var trig = document.getElementById('roulette-trigger');
    if (trig) { trig.addEventListener('click', function () { $('#rouletteModal').modal('show'); reflowRouletteModalPreflight(); loadState(renderModal); }); }
    var bf = document.getElementById('rlt-spin-free'); if (bf) { bf.addEventListener('click', function () { spin('free'); }); }
    var bp = document.getElementById('rlt-spin-paid'); if (bp) { bp.addEventListener('click', function () { spin('tokens'); }); }
    loadState();
    $('#rouletteModal').on('shown', function () { reflowRouletteModalPreflight(); reflowRouletteModal(); });
    window.addEventListener('resize', function () { reflowRouletteModal(); });
  });
})();
    $(document).ready(function () {
        $("#up").click(function () {
            var curPos = $(document).scrollTop();
            var scrollTime = curPos / 200;
            $("body,html").animate({"scrollTop": 0}, scrollTime);
        });

        $("#down").click(function () {
            var curPos = $(document).height();
            var scrollTime = curPos / 200;
            $("body,html").animate({"scrollTop": $(document).height()}, scrollTime);
        });

        $('.search-query').autoComplete({
            source: function (term, suggest) {
                $.ajax({
                    url: '/search/autocomplete',
                    data: {
                        query: term
                    },
                    complete: function (data) {
                        suggest(data.responseJSON)
                    }
                })
            },
            renderItem: function (item, search) {
                // XSS protection: escape HTML in titles
                const escapeHtml = (text) => {
                    const div = document.createElement('div');
                    div.textContent = text;
                    return div.innerHTML;
                };
                
                search = search.replace(/[-\/\\^$*+?.()|[\]{}]/g, '\\$&');
                let re = new RegExp("(" + search.split(' ').join('|') + ")", "gi");
                
                const escapedTitle1 = escapeHtml(item.title_one);
                const escapedTitle2 = escapeHtml(item.title_two);
                
                return `
            <div class="autocomplete-suggestion" data-url="${item.url}">
                <table>
                    <tr>
                        <td>
                            <div class="autocomplete-suggestion-img">
                                <img src="${item.img}">
                            </div>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                            <div class="title">${escapedTitle1.replace(re, "<mark>$1</mark>")}</div>
                            <div class="title">${escapedTitle2.replace(re, "<mark>$1</mark>")}</div>
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                </table>
            </div>`;
            },
            onSelect: function (e, term, item) {
                document.location.href = $(item).data('url');
            }
        });

        $("[rel='tooltip']").tooltip();

        $('a[data-dismiss="alert"]').on('click', (e) => {
            const id = $(e.target.parentElement).data('id');
            const date = new Date(new Date().getTime() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
            document.cookie = `alert_${id}=true; expires=${date.toUTCString()}; path=/`;
        });

        $("a[href^='/site/proxy']").on('click', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const modal = $('#external-link-popup');
            const link = new URL(this.href);
            const url = link.pathname + link.search + link.hash;
            const href = url.replace('/site/proxy?l=', '');
            modal.find('.ext-link').attr('href', href);
            modal.find('.ext-link').html(href);

            modal.modal('show');
        });

        // Обработка клика по кнопке обновления счётчика прибыли
        $('.refresh-income').click(function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            
            // Добавляем анимацию вращения для иконки обновления
            $(this).addClass('rotating');
            
            // Отправляем AJAX-запрос для обновления счётчика
            $.ajax({
                url: '/users/refreshIncome',
                type: 'POST',
                dataType: 'json',
                data: {
                    'csrf_token': 'TE81Z1dKNUNJWHZiN1VFbDhfWkFielFXWG9BMVg5SlKnXzuhzTvuCjWuvRu58uAh45DYRbwAx7mHaeyaK9SGnA=='
                },
                success: function(data) {
                    if (data.success) {
                        // Обновляем значение в счётчике
                        $('.income-value').text(data.income);
                        
                        // Показываем или скрываем счётчик в зависимости от значения

                }
            });
        });
